description_expanded: Tucked into the heart of historic Grayton Beach , Sweaty Palms is a classic 2-bedroom, 1-bath cottage that blends vintage charm with thoughtful modern updates. This single-level retreat sleeps up to 4 guests and offers an unbeatable location just a short walk from the beach and the beloved Red Bar. Guests rave about the welcoming screened porch, shady yard, and one of the best-equipped kitchens they’ve ever used—perfect for a fresh seafood feast or a laid-back beach breakfast. Inside, the home strikes a balance between cheerful design and cozy comfort. Crisp shiplap walls, warm hardwood floors, and coastal art create a nostalgic cottage feel, while quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances add a polished, modern edge. The living area includes a cushioned sofa and wicker chairs, ideal for unwinding after a day in the sun. Central air conditioning and a washer and dryer make longer stays especially easy. The outdoor spaces are a true highlight. A large screened front porch invites morning coffee from nearby Black Bear Bread Co. bakery or breezy evenings with a good book. Out back, the sunny deck offers a pergola-shaded dining area and a grill, all overlooking a lush grassy lawn—perfect for lawn games or simply enjoying the quiet, private setting. Guests love how the home feels peaceful and tucked away, yet close to everything. You're just a 2-minute walk from the Gulf’s shimmering shoreline, with Grayton Beach State Park and scenic Western Lake nearby for paddleboarding, fishing, or nature walks. Walk to local favorites like Chiringo and the Zoo Gallery, or hop on the seasonal shuttle to explore more of north Grayton—and beyond. Scenic 30A is lined with charming beach towns like Seaside, WaterColor, and Blue Mountain Beach, each offering their own mix of dining, shopping, and live music. Whether it’s a couple’s getaway or a family beach escape, Sweaty Palms offers a timeless Grayton experience with all the right comforts. All One Level: Living Room with Screened Porch Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom, Bedroom with Two Twins, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo.
